name: Sophie Danforth Conservation Biology Fund

funder.name: Roger Williams Park Zoo and Rhode Island Zoological Society

summary: Annual grants for field studies and other conservation projects that protect threatened wildlife and habitats worldwide, awarded to organisations such as NGOs or universities, with no zoo partnership needed. The amount is not stated on the page.

eligibility.rule: Affiliated with an organization capable of receiving funds
Avoid highly invasive or terminal research and specimen collection or vouchering
Use no AI to draft, edit or generate application content; disclose permitted mechanical use
Requests funding only for activities that were not completed before funding
Requests a first or second year of SDCBF support for this project

documents: Two signed letters of recommendation dated within the past year, from different individuals
W-9 for U.S. citizens or U.S.-based organisations receiving funds, W-8 for non-U.S. recipients
First-year progress report, when seeking a second year of funding for the same project

status.quote: Applications are now open and will be accepted through January 1st, 2027

applicant_types.quote: Applicants must be affiliated with an organization (e.g., NGO, university) capable of receiving funds.

geography.quote: supports conservation programs that protect threatened wildlife and habitats worldwide.

access.quote: Applications are now open and will be accepted through January 1st, 2027

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be affiliated with an organization (e.g., NGO, university) capable of receiving funds.
Projects involving highly invasive or terminal research, or those requiring the collection/vouchering of specimens, will not be considered.

applicants may not use AI tools to draft, edit, or generate content for any portion of the application. Any application containing AI-generated material will be considered ineligible. Limited use of AI for mechanical tasks (e.g., grammar correction, formatting, data organization) is permitted only if fully disclosed within the application.
All applications must be submitted in English.
Expenses for project activities completed prior to funding are not eligible.
Projects previously funded by SDCBF are eligible for a second year of support

after_award.quote: Progress report due: April 30, 2028 (must include project updates and budgetary expenditures).

documents.quote: Curriculum Vitae (two page maximum). 3. Two letters of recommendation, each from a different individual familiar with the applicant and the proposal.
Two letters of recommendation must be signed, and dated within the past year.

W-9 Form - Required for U.S. citizens or U.S.-based organizations receiving funds. Download IRS W-9 Form W-8 Form - Required for non-U.S. individuals or organizations receiving funds; certifies foreign status for tax purposes.
A progress report from the first year is included.
